title: Maximum Sum of 3 Non-Overlapping Subarrays

solutions.optimal:
class Solution:
    def maxSumOfThreeSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        sums = []
        cur = sum(nums[:k])
        sums.append(cur)
        for i in range(k, n):
            cur += nums[i] - nums[i - k]
            sums.append(cur)
        m = len(sums)
        left = [0] * m
        best = 0
        for i in range(m):
            if sums[i] > sums[best]:
                best = i
            left[i] = best
        right = [0] * m
        best = m - 1
        for i in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
            if sums[i] >= sums[best]:
                best = i
            right[i] = best
        best_sum = -1
        ans = []
        for mid in range(k, m - k):
            l = left[mid - k]
            r = right[mid + k]
            total = sums[l] + sums[mid] + sums[r]
            cand = [l, mid, r]
            if total > best_sum or (total == best_sum and cand < ans):
                best_sum = total
                ans = cand
        return ans
